name: MailSync – An Extension For Mailcoach and Gravity Forms
author: Pritam

sections.description: Seamlessly connect your Gravity Forms submissions with your Mailcoach email marketing platform to automate your subscriber management. With this integration, you can automatically add form entries as subscribers to a specific Mailcoach email list. Whether you’re collecting newsletter signups, webinar registrations, or contact requests, this setup ensures your audience data flows directly into your Mailcoach campaigns—without manual exports.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload mailsync.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
